


MaAsLin2_species_barplot.pdf
```{r}

# Species-level MaAsLin2 coefficient plot
# This script generates the species-level summary figure
# from the differential-abundance results produced by
# Microbiome_MaAsLin2.Rmd.

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)

# ==============================
#Read combined MaAsLin2 output
# ==============================
base_dir <- "Maaslin2_output_no13"

df <- read_excel(
  file.path(base_dir, "Maaslin2_Combined_TaxLevels_SampleType.xlsx"),
  sheet = "All_SampleType_Associations"
)

# ==============================
#Filter species-level significant results
# ==============================
df_species <- df %>%
  filter(Level == "Species", qval <= 0.25) %>%
  mutate(
    species = feature %>%
      str_replace("^s_", "") %>%
      str_replace("^s__", "") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " "),
    abs_coef = abs(coef),
    Group = factor(value, levels = c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")),
    Direction = ifelse(coef > 0, "Increased", "Decreased")
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^Other", species))

# ==============================
# Create output directory
# ==============================
output_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "MaAsLin2_LDAfig_species")

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save filtered full table
write.csv(
  df_species,
  file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin2_species_filtered.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==============================
# Select top taxa by absolute effect size
# ==============================
top_species <- df_species %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_coef)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  arrange(coef)

write.csv(
  top_species,
  file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin2_top_species.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==============================
# Plot: signed coefficient + colored by group
# ==============================

p <- ggplot(
  top_species,
  aes(
    x = coef,
    y = reorder(species, coef),
    fill = Group
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "ALC" = "#E45756",
      "CB" = "#4C78A8",
      "ALC+CB" = "#72B7B2"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "ALC" = "Alcohol",
      "CB" = "Cannabinoid",
      "ALC+CB" = "Alcohol + Cannabinoid"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14,
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top Differentially Abundant Species by MaAsLin2 (q ≤ 0.25)",
    x = "MaAsLin2 effect size coefficient",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  )

print(p)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin2_species_barplot_by_group.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6
)

# ==============================
# Highlight selected SCFA-related taxa
# ==============================

butyrate_taxa <- c(
  "Faecalibacterium prausnitzii D",
  "Gemmiger formicilis",
  "Roseburia hominis"
)

other_scfa_taxa <- c(
  "Blautia A wexlerae",
  "Blautia coccoides A",
  "Dorea muris"
)

top_species <- top_species %>%
  mutate(
    species_factor = factor(species, levels = unique(species[order(coef)]))
  )

label_colors <- case_when(
  levels(top_species$species_factor) %in% butyrate_taxa ~ "#1f4e79",
  levels(top_species$species_factor) %in% other_scfa_taxa ~ "#7A3E9D",
  TRUE ~ "black"
)

p_highlight <- ggplot(
  top_species,
  aes(
    x = coef,
    y = species_factor,
    fill = Group
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "ALC" = "#E45756",
      "CB" = "#4C78A8",
      "ALC+CB" = "#72B7B2"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", color = label_colors),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "MaAsLin2 coefficient",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  )

print(p_highlight)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "MaAsLin2_species_barplot_by_group_highlight.pdf"),
  plot = p_highlight,
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)
```
